subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should `readRequestBodyWithLimit` publicly support `destroyOnError: false` through `openclaw/plugin-sdk/webhook-ingress`, making response completion and request teardown the caller's responsibility?
rationale: The Copilot plugin needs a way to send deterministic HTTP errors, but choosing whether that ownership mode becomes a supported external plugin contract cannot be resolved from correctness tests alone.

options.title: Approve the narrow additive option
options.body: Keep the default destructive behavior, document the opt-out ownership contract, and require Copilot to await response completion before destroying the request.

options.title: Keep teardown internal
options.body: Remove the public option and provide a non-public or plugin-local bounded reader, accepting some duplication to avoid expanding the plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow additive option
recommendation.body: Keep the default destructive behavior, document the opt-out ownership contract, and require Copilot to await response completion before destroying the request.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets the permanent public plugin SDK boundary and Copilot runtime ownership model.
